reasons.text: Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 80% of months
45% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
Category III share of certificates is 74%, +72% versus what its process route can produce
Sold products equal only 23% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.85x the cost floor)
In 100% of months, product sales fall far short of the claimed input

inspection_checklist: Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
